title: Hop Size Overlap Visualizer
description: A sample stream with successive 512-sample frame windows drawn as overlapping bars, and a readout of overlap percentage, update rate, and the resulting FFT cost multiplier.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Real-Time Systems
STFT

educational.topic: Hop size, frame overlap, and recomputation cost
learningObjectives: Examine frame overlap as a function of hop size
Compare update rate against FFT cost
Determine a sustainable hop from a compute budget
prerequisites: A frame is a block of samples

assumptions: Frame size fixed at 512 samples, sampling rate 16 kHz
One FFT per frame regardless of overlap
limitations: The frame stack is truncated to fit the panel; the caption states how many of the total are shown

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Geometric view paired with a quantitative cost readout
keyQuestions: How many times is each sample processed at 75% overlap?
What is the smallest hop your compute budget allows?
commonMisconceptions: That overlapping frames improve the display for free
assessmentOpportunities: Determine the smallest sustainable hop from a measured FFT time
